commit.subject: LU-20264 llite: set op_idmap in the rename path
commit.message:
LU-20264 llite: set op_idmap in the rename path

Store the caller's mnt_idmap in op_idmap for the rename RPC issued by
ll_rename(), so renames on an idmapped mount carry the same mapping as
the other MDS operations.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: I8cf1ddab85b7143e6d80f146eabad1036a6a6964
